clock_assumption: Row i received at i*900000000000; decision at receipt+1. Source timezone and historical availability are unknown. These invented clocks only exercise the bridge.
comparison: Report model and both baselines without a success threshold for predictive accuracy
initial_candidate: Zero head implies persistence exactly in raw-output arithmetic; checkpoint selection still uses trained epochs 1..6 as in v1
initialization: Same dedicated seeded Xavier body as v1; consume the same RNG draws, then zero scalar head weight and bias
limitations: Engineering demonstration, not independent forecast validation or financial evidence
Only first 3072 rows used for fitting, predictions and scoring; complete source file hashed and structurally validated
Overlapping windows and previously inspected development data
No current-runtime latency comparison; Torch 2.2.2 is the available local reference
purpose: Bounded CPU training/export/feature-replay engineering demonstration; not a new predictive study
selection: lowest validation MAE in original units; strict improvement; earliest epoch wins ties
shuffle: one full permutation per epoch; dedicated CPU generator seeded seed+1000
stopping: Exactly two epochs, one seed; select earliest lowest validation MAE; no outcome-dependent extension
test_policy: Demo evaluation in an already developmental early slice; reserved tail unused
